verdict.rationale: skills.sh is a skills registry and CLI package manager. It installs SKILL.md files into agent directories and has no production data or service environments of its own, so a sandbox-vs-production testing environment is a category error for this product type. The closest feature, `skills use` writing skill files to a temporary directory, lets you try a skill without installing it; it is not an isolated environment that keeps you away from production data, so it does not make this axis apply.
